version_localization.promotionalText: Track your collection, browse master sets, open public collector walls, and follow the cards that matter most.
version_localization.description:
Grookai Vault helps Pokemon card collectors identify exact cards, organize their collection, and connect around the cards they care about.

Search the card catalog, scan a card, choose the correct printing and finish, and keep every owned copy organized in your Vault. Browse sets, track Grookai Dex progress, build Binders, and use your Wall to showcase selected cards.

Discover collectors, follow their public activity, and open card-centered conversations with the exact card and collector context preserved. Grookai keeps canonical card identity, ownership, intent, and collection context connected across the experience.

review_detail.notes: Use the supplied review account to verify sign-in, Search, Scan, exact-printing selection, Vault, Binders, Wall, Dex, Sets, collector discovery, Following, and card-centered messaging. Personal collection and messaging surfaces require authentication. Account deletion instructions are available at https://grookaivault.com/account/delete.
